# cortex-ia — Full System Context

cortex-ia is the deterministic multi-agent control plane, transactional OpenCode installer, and Herdr process multiplexer.

## Architecture Packages

```text
cmd/cortex-ia/               main(): release version + internal/app
internal/app/                CLI command dispatch (board, work, delegate, openspec, mcp, web)
internal/delegation/         ACID SQLite engine: DAG, CAS revisions, claims, file leases, reviews
internal/cortexiaweb/        Embedded Preact web console with SSE real-time event streaming
internal/herdr/              Herdr workspace discovery, pane splitting & process multiplexing
internal/tui/                Bubble Tea interactive wizard
internal/install/            Service facade: install, sync, doctor, rollback, uninstall
internal/pipeline/           Transactional plan, backup, apply, rollback engine
internal/backup/             Snapshot manifests and restoration
internal/mcpmanager/         Managed MCP catalog (cortex, context7)
internal/state/              Installation metadata, accreditation digests & cross-process locks
internal/components/filemerge JSONC three-way merger with comment preservation
internal/assets/             go:embed runtime assets (AGENTS.md, agents, commands, skills, plugins)
```

## Planes & Boundaries

1. **Epistemic & Evidence Plane (Cortex MCP)**:
   - Evaluates code symbols, call hierarchies, and AST blast radius (`cortex_code_scan`, `cortex_get_blast_radius`).
   - Stores durable gotchas, bug root causes, ADRs, and session milestones (`cortex_save`, `cortex_search`).
   - Advisory only: never bypasses review gates or grants write authority.

2. **Control & Coordination Plane (Cortex-IA CLI)**:
   - Authoritative SQLite ACID state machine (`~/.cortex-ia/delegation.db`).
   - Task DAG: `backlog ➔ ready ➔ in_progress ➔ in_review ➔ done`.
   - CAS monotonic revision locking: prevents concurrent race conditions between subagents.
   - Exclusive file leases: mandatory workspace-relative path locks before writing.
   - Independent peer review: implementers cannot approve their own work.

3. **Specification Plane (OpenSpec)**:
   - Markdown delta specifications with RFC 2119 keywords (`openspec/changes/`).
   - Validated natively via `openspec validate` / `cortex-ia openspec validate`.

4. **Delegation & Multiplexing Plane (Herdr / AGY)**:
   - Dedicated terminal panes running external workers.
   - Sub-second NDJSON stream telemetry: tool calls, live activity spinners, and streamed textual reasoning.

## Complete CLI Reference

- `cortex-ia`: Launch interactive TUI
- `cortex-ia board create <id> "<title>" "[desc]"`
- `cortex-ia board list`
- `cortex-ia board status <id>` (aliases: `show`, `get`)
- `cortex-ia board serve [--addr 127.0.0.1:7331]`
- `cortex-ia work create <id> "<title>" --board <id> [--depends <id>]...`
- `cortex-ia work list [--board <id>]`
- `cortex-ia work status <id>` (aliases: `show`, `get`)
- `cortex-ia work claim <id> --owner <owner> [--ttl 15m]`
- `cortex-ia work renew <id> --claim-token <tok> [--ttl 15m]`
- `cortex-ia work lease <id> --claim-token <tok> --path <file> [--ttl 15m]`
- `cortex-ia work lease-renew --path <file> --lease-token <tok>`
- `cortex-ia work release --path <file> --lease-token <tok>`
- `cortex-ia work transition <id> --claim-token <tok> --to <in_review|in_progress|blocked>`
- `cortex-ia work approve <id> --reviewer <id> --verdict <PASS|FAIL> [--evidence <ref>]`
- `cortex-ia work retry <id>`
- `cortex-ia work recover`
- `cortex-ia delegate create --request-file <req.json> [--transport direct|herdr]`
- `cortex-ia delegate worker --job <id> --request-file <req.json>`
- `cortex-ia delegate status <id>`
- `cortex-ia delegate result <id>`
- `cortex-ia delegate recover`
- `cortex-ia openspec validate [dir]`
- `cortex-ia openspec list`
- `cortex-ia openspec status [dir]`
- `cortex-ia web [--open] [--addr 127.0.0.1:7331]`
- `cortex-ia install [--dry-run] [--overwrite]`
- `cortex-ia sync [--dry-run]`
- `cortex-ia doctor`
- `cortex-ia mcp add|list|remove`
- `cortex-ia rollback <snapshot-id>`
